description: Show a saved artifact to the user as an inline card they can expand and scroll, in hosts that draw cards. Call it once after create_artifact or update_artifact saves one, after generate_artifact's session reports the saved artifact, or when the user asks to see an existing artifact. Returns its title, description and viewer link; nothing about the artifact changes. Where the host draws the card, the user can already see the artifact: say in a sentence what it shows and do not repeat its contents. Where no card appears, give the user the artifactUrl.

fileId.description: The artifact's .artifact folder ID, as create_artifact, update_artifact or list_files returned it; never an embedded report file ID.

name: show_artifact
title: Show artifact
